correction: The live note in .rah/state/status.json and .rah/state/gates.json was rewritten to describe E05-0001 by its own title and to name F05-0001 as next. The sealed generations were not touched: the generation manifest covers .rah/ralph/** payloads only, so neither state file is hashed into any generation, and the E05-0001 seal verify still passes unchanged. The seal sources are left byte-identical because their hashes are recorded in the sealed E0165/E0166 summaries and in report.json output_artifacts; rewriting one would break the chain it is evidence for.
defect: Three seals derived in sequence from the C05 seal carried C05's description into their live-status note: C06-0001, D05-0001 and E05-0001 each wrote 'evolution genome, evaluator, archive, statistics and adapter schema bundle ... Q02-0001 is next'. The derivation rebased the package id token but not the description or the next-package name. Only the last seal to run sets the live note, so the observable defect was E05-0001's.
detected_by: Stop-hook challenge to prove the stored RALPH state evidences a verified completion, followed by a direct read of .rah/state/status.json
impact: The live implementation_gate_note misnamed the last sealed package's subject and pointed at an already-sealed next package. No sealed evidence, artifact hash, generation, or gate status was affected: E0161-E0166 each describe their own package correctly, implementation_gate stayed fail and completion_ready stayed false throughout, and the gate's evidence_ids binding was already correct.
prevention: A seal derivation must rebase the note description and the next-package name, not only the package id token. The next seal generator asserts the note names its own package before writing.
verified_after_correction: live note names E05-0001 and F05-0001
